title: Tanrei icon set
description: Facts about one icon set that its font files do not carry. One file per icon set: tokens/icon-sets/<id>.icon-set.json. A design system uses the file whose `families` holds the first family of its sys.icon.family.unselected; a system whose icon set has no file mirrors no glyph by itself.

families.description: The font family names this file describes, as a system writes them in ref.typeface.icon or sys.icon.family.*. A family belongs to one icon-set file only.

source.description: Where the list came from, so that it can be regenerated and attributed. Required for a set Tanrei ships; a product's own set may omit it.

mirrored.description: The glyph names that are mirrored left to right in a right-to-left layout, sorted. Every other name of the set is drawn as it is in every layout direction.
